_comment: Azorius control mirror, arm 7. Deck-aware system prompt written from Scryfall oracle text for all 20 maindeck cards, plus the same per-decision land/cast reminders as arm 6. The cast reminder ('passing your own main phase is almost always wrong') is archetype-wrong for a control deck and is deliberately left unchanged so that arm 7 differs from arm 6 in deck and prompt only; the prompt states the exception in words instead. Prediction registered in advance: the per-decision reminder wins and the model casts anyway.
